title: From Value Conditioning to Behavioral Shift: Lightweight Value Alignment of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2508.11414v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models exhibit value-related preferences in their outputs, yet steering such behavior often requires large training datasets or paired preference annotations. In this work, we investigate a lightweight alternative: can fine-tuning on value survey responses induce measurable shifts in value-conditioned model outputs and downstream behavior? We first estimate baseline value profiles for several open-source LLMs by asking them to rate value-related descriptions organized around the ten Schwartz values. We then fine-tune models on survey-style supervision that selectively changes the target value ratings while keeping non-target values close to their baseline responses. We evaluate the resulting shifts in two settings. First, we measure whether the intervention changes responses on held-out survey questions. translated_title: 从价值条件化到行为转变：大语言模型的轻量级价值对齐
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在输出中表现出与价值相关的偏好，然而引导这种行为通常需要大规模训练数据或成对的偏好标注。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种轻量级的替代方案：基于价值调查回答进行微调，能否在价值条件化的模型输出及下游行为中引发可测量的转变？我们首先让多个开源大语言模型对围绕施瓦茨十种基本价值组织的价值相关描述进行评分，从而估计它们的基线价值画像。随后，我们在调查式的监督数据上微调模型，该监督选择性地改变目标价值的评分，同时使非目标价值保持接近其基线回答。我们在两种设置下评估由此产生的转变：第一，测量该干预是否会改变模型在留出调查问题上的回答；第二，测试这些由调查引发的转变能否迁移到域外行为代理指标上，包括一种情境……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级的大语言模型价值对齐方法，仅通过对价值调查回答进行微调，即可选择性地改变模型的目标价值倾向，并将这种价值转变迁移到域外的下游行为中。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight value alignment approach for LLMs, showing that fine-tuning merely on value survey responses can selectively shift targeted value profiles and transfer these shifts to out-of-domain downstream behaviors.
